scope: GNH comprehensive-report contract, explicit public-view projections, and Python/TypeScript location response parity

checks.ruff: passed for changed Python source and tests
checks.python_compile: passed for changed Python source and tests

contracts.gnh_alignment: Strict success/error projection; report and each assessment are bound to the selected location; fields and domain match the public view; average score is checked against the generator's rounded non-null-score mean.
contracts.regenerative_outcomes_projection: Explicit ordered projection of all 25 current public-view columns; location/date filters, ordering, serialized row shape, and hectares aggregate are preserved.
contracts.time_liberation_projection: Explicit ordered projection of all 16 current public-view columns; location/date filters, ordering, serialized row shape, and hours aggregate are preserved.
contracts.public_location_sdk: Python and TypeScript list/detail responses require the exact Gateway field set, valid UUID syntax, nullable string country/region fields, and active status; invalid envelopes use existing SDK error types.

content_review: Existing public narratives, arrays, and metadata remain in their payloads. These checks establish contract and projection parity, not content-level privacy or populated-data parity.
